## What does this change do?
Describe the user problem, scope, and expected behavior.

## Type
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Independent extension proposal or sample (not installable)
- [ ] Other public repository improvement

## Contributor safety checklist
- [ ] I used no private Hubzam Works™ source, credentials, customer data, or proprietary internal information.
- [ ] I own or have permission to submit all source and assets; included a clear license for any extension code.
- [ ] I listed dependencies, external connections, requested permissions, and data handling.
- [ ] I included tests using fictional data, or explained why not applicable.
- [ ] I understand PR approval/merge does not install or deploy my submission.

## How was this tested?
Explain reproducible steps and attach non-sensitive evidence.

## Risks and limitations
Describe security, licensing, accessibility, or compatibility uncertainties.
